category_title: Student with TBI who makes disrespectful comments and draws during work
scenario_title: Independent hard task worksheets without teacher attention
minimal_context: Zeke is assigned an independent math worksheet in the pull-out special education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your independent math worksheet. Please complete these problems on your own.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even have a pencil or anything to write with.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is a pencil. Go ahead and start working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes the pencil and starts drawing pictures on the desk) This work is stupid and I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop drawing and focus on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns to a classmate sitting nearby) What are you looking at? Mind your own business or I'll punch you in the face.
